title: Farming decisions, backed by real data

districtsBody: Live weather, a 7-day forecast and irrigation advice for all 64 districts. Tap your district on the map or search by name.
cropsBody: Growing calendars, practical guidance and market prices for key crops.
scanBody: Photograph a leaf and the AI suggests the likely problem and what to do next.
climateBody: Rainfall and temperature compared with normal for each division, plus disaster alerts.
askBody: Questions about crops, fish, pests or weather — answered in your language.
